title: File management tools either have duplicate context menu items or none at all in extended menu

judgment.rationale: Reuse the existing Image Resizer/PowerRename menu-registration trackers and preserve File Locksmith as a distinct coverage question. Do not retain a blanket waiting-on-author judgment or claim closed historical duplicates prove all three utilities fixed.
evidence: The report separately demonstrates combined and extended-only menu modes for PowerRename, Image Resizer and File Locksmith.
The October 22 follow-up reports duplicate entries returning after updates; the previous claim that no follow-up exists is stale.
Existing trackers cover portions, not a confirmed single shared root cause or fixed release.
Read #20255, #30694, #49416 and the linked historical menu reports as partial coverage; none establishes a released all-tools fix.

reproduce.title: Validate Explorer context menus report
reproduce.version_requirement: Current stable release; compare the reported version only in an isolated test environment if needed.
prerequisites: Use a disposable test account or controlled test machine; preserve existing user data.
steps: On current stable, select local files and record the modern and classic menus for each affected tool.
Compare combined and extended-only modes, then repeat after an update/repair in a disposable account.
Keep tool-specific registration outcomes separate; do not delete registry entries on a user's machine.
reproduce.expected_result: Each enabled command appears exactly once on its configured surface; any uncovered tool-specific failure is documented.
